element.name: Metaform
element.work: A knowledge graph of a project's functions, recorded once and served to agents and people over CLI, MCP and a web GUI.

element.name: coding agent
element.work: The AI agent that works on the project and needs its purpose before it works.

join.purpose: Take up the work assigned to it and report each step on the nodes the work touches.
join.ef: gives the agent its ticket's prompt and namespace nodes when it runs metaform <nonce>, then takes the ticket, plans its steps and reports each one

join.purpose: Start each piece of work already knowing what each part of the project is for, what relies on it and what it relies on.
join.ef: returns, for any address, the element, the joins that hold it and the joins it holds, with the layers and memory in context there

join.purpose: Give each element a type a model already understands, from trunk to leaf.
join.ef: reads an address backward through its name_length into the element's short name, under the five root types code, document, media, data and stakeholder

join.purpose: Keep every element and join, and every version of each, durable and consistent for every reader and writer.
join.ef: stores the metaform one row per thing, each write one transaction and each read one index read, applying select, mask and hiding inside every read and keeping every version a refinement writes

join.purpose: Hold each store in a file that survives concurrent writers and stores written at an earlier layout.
join.ef: opens each store with WAL, foreign keys and a busy timeout, reads the schema version before anything else, and upgrades an earlier layout in place

join.purpose: Open the store of the project the call is made for, kept outside the project's folder.
join.ef: resolves the folder's project and keeps one folder per project under the Metaform home, with its own project.sqlite3 holding its registration and metaforms

join.purpose: Be called by agents as tools and by people as commands, from one set of verbs.
join.ef: exposes each map verb as metaform map <verb> on the command line and as a command of the map tool over MCP

join.purpose: Expose each module's verbs on every surface from the module's one declaration.
join.ef: runs each verb as metaform <module> <verb> on the command line and as the command <verb> of the tool <module> over MCP, with the same help, errors and results on both

join.purpose: Take each switch a verb reads as a setting, with one meaning everywhere it is used.
join.ef: parses, validates, defaults and documents every setting from the one schema its module declares, as default, set or glued, per folder or global

join.purpose: Show and stage every setting on one screen in the terminal.
join.ef: draws the settings screen the chassis and every module declare, and saves staged changes through the settings module

join.purpose: Speak to AI tools in the protocol they launch servers with.
join.ef: serves every surfaced module verb as a tool over stdio through the official SDK's low-level server, with the instructions composed again for each request

join.purpose: Let a module hear what other modules publish, in this process and in every other process of the home.
join.ef: delivers each published topic to every loaded subscriber with its own Context, and hands map.changed to listeners in other processes over a loopback port

join.purpose: Know which of Metaform's features are active here and how to use them before it acts.
join.ef: composes the chassis instructions with each surfaced module's instructions, live for the folder, as metaform help agents and as the MCP server's instructions

join.purpose: Correct a wrong or missing inference at the node where it found it, so the next agent reading that node sees the correction.
join.ef: records entities, observations and relations in the reference memory server's terms and ties them to the node by a memory join

join.purpose: Present memory in the terms agents already use for it.
join.ef: offers the reference memory server's entity, relation and observation tools at each node, kept in project-level tables a clear of the metaforms leaves in place

element.name: MCP reference memory server
element.work: The external tool interface the memory module presents: entities, relations and observations.

join.purpose: See exactly the knowledge in scope at its position in the map, and none that was hidden or masked there.
join.ef: selects and masks layers from trunk to leaf, so every read at an address returns only the layers that reach it

element.name: module author
element.work: Adds a capability to Metaform as a module.

join.purpose: Add a capability to Metaform as a module declared once in its own folder, running as a metaform command and an MCP tool with its own settings, events and lifecycle, without changing the chassis.
join.ef: reads the module's literal declarations without running it, loads it from the system, user, entry-point or project place, and gives each verb a Context with the project, store, folder and settings; the template supplies the empty start and hello exercises every feature once

join.purpose: Change Metaform and know every requirement still holds on Linux, macOS and Windows.
join.ef: runs the tests tagged with the requirement each protects, strict pyright and ruff, in CI on all three systems, under the rules the repository gives agents that work on it

join.purpose: Protect each requirement by the record it comes from.
join.ef: states each requirement with its reason, its build detail and the tests that protect it, and wins where it and the code differ

element.name: Metaform specification
element.work: specifications/00-index.md makes this folder the contract. HANDOFF.md still describes the fix pass stopped after step 11, the viewer not yet built and an uncommitted src/metaform/data/corrections.py; the web GUI exists and corrections.py does not. The index's absorbed sources are under ../rich/, which this project folder does not hold.

join.purpose: Take in older material only where it matches the specification.
join.ef: holds superseded intake samples, proposals, feature briefs and an older docs dump that name files this project no longer has

element.name: superseded design material
element.work: out.md is a dump of an older docs/ tree; specs/ holds earlier intake samples and code_metaform XML results and a superseded agent-surface proposal; feature-briefs/ cite docs/SPEC.md, docs/semantics/ and docs/rulebook/, which this project does not have.

element.name: intake agent
element.work: The agent that performs the intake: it examines the workpiece and records its functional map.

join.purpose: Record a project's functional understanding once, one object per call as it is reasoned, so later work starts from it instead of reasoning it again.
join.ef: serves the intake method, records each element and join into an intake layer no context read sees while it builds, reads it back whole or one receiver at a time, and activates it at finish

join.purpose: Put what it records into the project's metaform, where every later reader finds it.
join.ef: writes each element and join into the metaform's intake layer and each element's refs into the sources layer

join.purpose: Give every intake the same method, word for word.
join.ef: serves Intake 2.1 as stored, with its prompt slot filled
join.work: The intake_file setting's help says an empty value means the Canonical Intake, but the module serves resources/Intake_2.1.md (intake/__init__.py, RESOURCE, line 41) and the specification says the Canonical Intake is no longer served.

element.name: editor backup files
element.work: Editor backups and a swap file. Canonical_Intake.xml~ sits in the intake module's resources folder, which the wheel packages, and holds a procedure the module no longer serves.

join.purpose: Leave its report on the project and its feedback on the process with the map it finished.
join.ef: saves each report, feedback and shape as a file in the home, outside the project folder, with one row in the active metaform

element.name: workflow author
element.work: Turns prompts into reusable Axiom subroutines agents call.

join.purpose: Turn an existing prompt into a reusable subroutine that agents call, hand off and return from, its authored words kept verbatim.
join.ef: ingests, authors and lexicalizes Axiom subroutines into knowledge layers and carries their calls, bound values, errors and returns, handing a call to a fresh agent by nonce

join.purpose: Keep subroutines where the map's knowledge already lives, attached to the element they serve.
join.ef: stores each workflow element and its logic as items of an ordinary knowledge layer, every saved version kept

join.purpose: Hand a call to a fresh agent and resume the caller when it returns.
join.ef: issues a callee nonce that the fresh agent redeems for only its current subroutine and values

element.name: prompts
element.work: prompts/README.md says the goal is to ingest these prompts into Metaform as bundled workflows. The workflow module ships no bundled workflow, and none of these prompts is recorded as one.

element.name: project manager
element.work: The person who directs agents' work on the project, watches the map and answers agents' questions.

join.purpose: Assign, order and track agents' work on the nodes it touches, and answer their questions where they arise.
join.ef: keeps work records on elements and joins as tickets on a board in priority order, with questions and messages left at the node each concerns

join.purpose: Keep each worker's files against one origin and bring back any variant.
join.ef: stores each variant as the files that differ from its origin and reconstructs, extracts or serves them

join.purpose: Start a history from a commit the repository already keeps.
join.ef: takes a repository's commit as the origin, whose files git keeps, or a full copy of a plain folder

join.purpose: Connect each AI tool to Metaform once.
join.ef: checks first and changes nothing, then registers the uvx launch in each chosen tool, copies the skill to it, and starts and proves the registered command

join.purpose: Register a command that starts the same Metaform on Linux, macOS and Windows.
join.ef: builds one wheel of the chassis and the enabled modules with their pure-Python dependencies, and registers its uvx launch

join.purpose: Prove the registered command really starts a server before it reports success.
join.ef: starts the command and speaks MCP 2026-07-28 to it, server/discover then tools/list, reading one JSON object per line

join.purpose: Know which AI tools are present and what each was given.
join.ef: finds each harness by the folder of its binary and records it once the agent says it is done provisioning it

element.name: Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI

join.purpose: Carry a project's work to another home and back without losing its identity or provenance.
join.ef: exports and imports the project as one JSON document by unique id, adding only what the target lacks, or writes it as a packet, a plain ZIP with its provenance and data sealed inside

join.purpose: Show whether a packet was changed after it was written.
join.ef: seals the provenance and data in an AES-256-GCM envelope keyed from the manifest, so a changed work file fails the manifest's hashes

join.purpose: Credit the container it carries over from Tempo.
join.ef: records which imported files the repository carries, from where and at which commit

element.name: NOTICE.md
element.work: NOTICE.md attributes src/metaform/modules/_imagegen.py and src/metaform/data/semantics/*.source.md, and points to sources.json and docs/rulebook/seed-sources.md; none of these exist in the project. It does not name the packet seal, which modules/packet/seal.py says is carried over from Tempo's tempo.data, version 3.

join.purpose: Register a workpiece folder as a project, and take its intake again from nothing when it needs to be.
join.ef: registers the folder as a project under the home, and clears its metaforms and reports while its registration, settings and history stay, with a backup restore brings back

join.purpose: Put an agent to work on a ticket, and message or stop it, without leaving the map.
join.ef: starts Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI on one ticket, one session per ticket in the project's folder, its notes and permission questions shown at the ticket's node

join.purpose: Hand a ticket to an agent by a number it runs.
join.ef: issues a nonce whose run gives the ticket's prompt and its namespace nodes, and closes it when the session ends

join.purpose: Drive a coding agent's session as its client.
join.ef: runs as the ACP client, with the agent's ACP adapter as a child process in its own process group, its standard input and output carrying the protocol

element.name: Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI

join.purpose: Set how Metaform behaves everywhere or for one folder and the folders below it.
join.ef: saves, glues and unsets each setting globally or per folder, and shows them on the settings screen or with config --show

join.purpose: Learn to install Metaform, run an intake and read and use its map.
join.ef: walks through install, intake, reading a map, layers, memory and extending, with a worked project example and the method's preprint

element.name: documentation
element.work: README.md says every join carries ef as one of two words, Function or Encounter, with a verb and a relation, and that an element is only its address, name_length and role. The store's shape, data/schema.py at layout 19, is a join of type, purpose, ef and ifd and an element of address, name_length, name and role. README also says the lexicalization producer is not a shipped command, while workflow lexicalize exists, and that it describes the chassis after build-log step 58.

join.purpose: Watch the map, its layers and each node's condition while agents record and change them.
join.ef: draws the metaform as a 3D graph and a 2D drill-in in the browser, redrawn on every map change, a node with missing work ghostly and one with broken work flashing red

join.purpose: Draw the graph, diagrams and editors in the browser from files it ships.
join.ef: renders the 3D force graph, the 2D diagram and the note editor from the vendored libraries

join.purpose: Redraw every open page as soon as the map changes in any process of the home.
join.ef: hears map.changed published by the command line, the MCP server or a dispatch runner, so nothing polls

join.purpose: Start the agent for a ticket from the board, by hand or automatically.
join.ef: starts waiting tickets on free agent glyphs while Autostart agents is checked, up to the dispatch-agents limit, and starts one ticket at a time from Start or Add Task

join.purpose: Show each ticket on the project's board and each node's open work in its panel.
join.ef: reads the store's work records for the board's columns, the cards' order and the panel's list of records with their notes, tasks and flags

element.name: blind-spot critic
element.work: Examines the metaform for functions and encounters the design lacks.

join.purpose: Find the functions and encounters the design should have and does not, and have the project answer each one.
join.ef: starts a blind-spot layer with the critic prompt and the whole metaform, records each challenge, and takes the project's A, B or C answer, an approved B becoming a plan

join.purpose: Read the whole metaform it critiques, purposes and encounters together.
join.ef: gives the critic every element and join of the active metaform with the critic prompt
